description: Source code for utility functions related to OMX (OpenMAX) error handling, color format description, and media image configuration within Android's media framework.

classes.name: DescribeColorFormatParams
classes.description: Parameter class for describing color format details.

classes.name: DescribeColorFormat2Params
classes.description: Extended parameter class for describing color format with additional media image info.

classes.name: MediaImage2
classes.description: Represents media image details, especially for color formats.

methods.name: StatusFromOMXError
methods.description: Converts OMX error codes to Android status_t codes.

methods.name: GetComponentRole
methods.description: Returns the component role string based on MIME type and encoder/decoder flag.

methods.name: SetComponentRole
methods.description: Sets the role of an OMX component node.

methods.name: DescribeColorFormat
methods.description: Describes the color format of an OMX node, with fallback to default description.

methods.name: IsFlexibleColorFormat
methods.description: Checks if a color format is flexible and returns its equivalent format.

methods.name: DescribeDefaultColorFormat
methods.description: Provides default description for YUV420 color formats.
